labels.en: A doorway that grows shy

labels.en: Footprints that arrive before you

labels.en: A pocket full of distances

labels.en: The color between warnings

labels.en: A machine that dreams in corners

labels.en: Silence with sharp edges

labels.en: A river learning to hesitate

labels.en: A shadow with a better memory

labels.en: The shape of almost

labels.en: Rust that remembers warmth

labels.en: Every repair rearranges the damage

labels.zh: 你越躲藏，世界越喧闹
labels.en: The world grows louder whenever you hide

labels.en: What you discard learns to return

labels.en: Success moves the starting line

labels.en: The smallest change chooses the next disaster

labels.en: Each copy forgets a different detail

labels.en: Your mistakes become someone else's tools

labels.en: The route changes once it is understood

labels.zh: 你喂养的东西，最终会成为天气
labels.en: What you feed becomes the weather

labels.en: The ending edits the beginning

labels.en: Every promise alters the terrain

labels.en: The cure changes who needs saving

labels.zh: 醒来时，你成了自己一直躲避的人
labels.en: You wake as the person you kept avoiding

labels.zh: 两个对手共用一个后果
labels.en: Two rivals share one consequence

labels.zh: 只有不听从时，向导才会存在
labels.en: Your guide exists only while you disobey

labels.zh: 陌生人由你没做出的选择构成
labels.en: The stranger is made from your missing choices

labels.zh: 每次达成一致，你们就交换身份
labels.en: You trade roles whenever you agree

labels.zh: 你的盟友记得另一段与你的友谊
labels.en: Your ally remembers a different friendship with you

labels.zh: 敌人正在保护未来的你
labels.en: The enemy is protecting your future self

labels.zh: 信任清晰可见，却无法被读懂
labels.en: Trust is visible but unreadable

labels.zh: 你是别人计划中的副作用
labels.en: You are the side effect of someone else's plan

labels.zh: 只有万物静止时，时钟才会前进
labels.en: The clock advances only when nothing moves

labels.zh: 昨天跑得比你更快
labels.en: Yesterday is faster than you

labels.zh: 暂停的地方，事情才会发生
labels.en: The pause is where things happen

labels.zh: 每个清晨都从更晚的一步开始
labels.en: Each morning starts one step later

labels.zh: 错过的节拍会变成障碍
labels.en: Every missed beat becomes an obstacle

labels.zh: 时间穿过物品，而不是穿过人
labels.en: Time travels through objects, not people

labels.en: Wait long enough and the rules swap places

labels.zh: 未来不断寄来残缺的指示
labels.en: The future keeps sending incomplete instructions

labels.zh: 一个不知道在等待什么的倒计时
labels.en: A countdown with no known event

labels.zh: 没人看着时，房间会变得更大
labels.en: The room grows larger when nobody watches

labels.zh: 每条边界都有不同的内部
labels.en: Every border has a different inside

labels.zh: 你越迷路，出口就越近
labels.en: The exit moves closer as you get lost

labels.zh: 连接大小而非楼层的楼梯
labels.en: A staircase connecting sizes, not floors

labels.zh: 只有被你命名的地方才能穿越
labels.en: You can cross only places you have named

labels.en: The map folds, but the world refuses

labels.en: Distance belongs to whoever measures it

labels.en: The center is outside

labels.en: Each wall remembers a different doorway

labels.zh: 警告是准确的，只是准确得不对
labels.en: The warning is accurate in the wrong way

labels.en: You can see intentions, never actions

labels.en: The map tells the truth one minute late

labels.zh: 每个人听见的目标都不一样
labels.en: Everyone hears a different objective

labels.zh: 缺失的信息会留下真实的空洞
labels.en: Missing information leaves physical gaps

labels.zh: 信号越清晰，含义越模糊
labels.en: The clearer the signal, the less it means

labels.zh: 你知道发生了什么，却不知道发生在谁身上
labels.en: You know what happened, but not to whom

labels.zh: 界面是目击者，不是向导
labels.en: The interface is a witness, not a guide

labels.zh: 你看不见的东西正在计分
labels.en: What you cannot see is keeping score

labels.en: A key that unlocks questions

labels.zh: 由旧方向织成的布
labels.en: Fabric woven from old directions

labels.zh: 一罐借来的回声
labels.en: A jar of borrowed echoes

labels.en: Warm metal that avoids touch

labels.en: A compass pointing to unfinished things

labels.zh: 记得每次折叠的纸
labels.en: Paper that remembers being folded

labels.zh: 一盏投下门而非光的灯
labels.en: A lamp that casts doorways instead of light

labels.zh: 移动会消耗关卡本身
labels.en: Movement spends the level itself

labels.zh: 囤积的资源会变成规则
labels.en: Hoarded resources become rules

labels.zh: 最安全的格子不能使用两次
labels.en: The safest tile cannot be used twice

labels.zh: 每当你熟练掌握，工具就会失去一种功能
labels.en: Mastery removes one function from the tool

labels.en: The score is also the inventory

labels.zh: 找到那枚不可能脚印的主人
labels.en: Find the owner of an impossible footprint

labels.zh: 从教程放弃解释的地方开始
labels.en: Begin where the tutorial gave up

labels.zh: 送出一封不断更换收件人的信
labels.en: Deliver a message that keeps changing recipients

labels.en: The menu is negotiating with the player

labels.zh: 两张加载画面之间的头目战
labels.en: A boss fight between two loading screens

labels.zh: 那些差点被你点到的东西正在评判你
labels.en: The things you almost clicked are judging you

labels.en: Keep your face or keep your name?

labels.en: If you cannot return, what should return in your place?

labels.en: Forgive the broken tool or mend it?

labels.zh: 保住它的形状，还是保住它的材料？
labels.en: Preserve its shape or preserve its material?

labels.zh: 哪一种未来应该继承你的错误？
labels.en: Which future should inherit your mistake?

labels.zh: 保住共同的语言，还是保住最后一个说话的人？
labels.en: Save the shared language or save its last speaker?

labels.en: Keep the shelter intact or make it truly yours?

labels.en: Would you save the witness if the evidence must disappear?

labels.zh: 让机器完成你，还是让自己保持未完成？
labels.en: Let the machine finish you or remain unfinished?

labels.zh: 不变地回家，还是变成那里需要的人？
labels.en: Return unchanged or become the person home needs?

labels.zh: 两份承诺中，哪一份应该变成谎言？
labels.en: Which of two promises should become false?

labels.zh: 请求帮助，还是继续让别人理解你？
labels.en: Ask for help or remain understood?

labels.zh: 留下你来过的痕迹，还是抹去追随它的危险？
labels.en: Leave proof you were here or erase the danger following it?

labels.zh: 废墟应该被允许记住什么？
labels.en: What should the ruins be allowed to remember?

labels.zh: 为了继续做自己，你愿意让谁失望？
labels.en: Whom would you disappoint to remain yourself?

labels.zh: 接受不完美的疗愈，还是保留完美的病症？
labels.en: Accept an imperfect cure or keep a perfect illness?

labels.zh: 当所有人离开后，还有什么属于大家？
labels.en: What belongs to everyone after everyone leaves?

labels.zh: 一把为向上坠落准备的伞
labels.en: An umbrella for falling upward

labels.zh: 一面会对面孔过敏的镜子
labels.en: A mirror allergic to faces

labels.zh: 疲惫机械结出的种子
labels.en: Seeds from exhausted mechanisms

labels.en: A staircase made of apologies

labels.en: A museum of temporary selves

labels.zh: 由错位入口涌成的潮汐
labels.en: A tide of misplaced entrances

labels.zh: 一支由缺失按钮组成的合唱团
labels.en: A choir of missing buttons

labels.zh: 一团仍有未了之事的尘埃

labels.en: A nest for abandoned rules

labels.en: The aftertaste of distance

labels.en: A calendar shedding its skin

labels.zh: 两次告别之间的缝线
labels.en: The seam between two goodbyes

labels.zh: 装满天气的工具箱

labels.en: Every shortcut teaches the maze to resist

labels.en: Every borrowed ability leaves behind a habit

labels.en: Whatever you stabilize begins growing elsewhere

labels.en: Every disguise outlives the person wearing it

labels.en: The map grows older whenever it is corrected

labels.en: Everything you rebuild finds a different owner

labels.en: The more fairly you divide it, the harder the pieces are to fit

labels.en: Every silence adds another participant

labels.en: You are your rival's imaginary childhood friend

labels.en: You can exchange shadows but not intentions

labels.en: Your successor arrives before you retire

labels.en: Everyone knows only your previous name

labels.en: The caretaker shrinks whenever their ward grows

labels.en: The town welcomes your absence more than your return

labels.en: Your copy is better at being you but wants it less

labels.en: Enemies communicate only by trading pieces of terrain

labels.en: Noon arrives one piece at a time

labels.en: Every third action happens yesterday

labels.zh: 节奏决定哪件物品先老去
labels.en: Rhythm decides which object ages

labels.en: Clocks borrow minutes from nearby wounds

labels.en: Missed appointments become characters

labels.zh: 一天只会在你没去过的地方重演
labels.en: The day repeats only in places you never visited

labels.zh: 只要你说出未来的名字，它就会暂停
labels.en: The future pauses whenever you name it

labels.zh: 夜晚从一个库存格走向下一个
labels.en: Night advances through the inventory slots

labels.zh: 回声比发出它的声音老得更快
labels.en: Echoes age faster than the sounds that made them

labels.zh: 在被布置之前，房间没有内部
labels.en: The room has no inside until it is furnished

labels.zh: 门在关闭时交换目的地
labels.en: Doors trade destinations whenever they close

labels.zh: 地平线藏在最小的物件里
labels.en: The horizon fits inside the smallest object

labels.zh: 每一块空白都有主人
labels.en: Every blank space has an owner

labels.zh: 走廊会围绕被拒绝的决定生长
labels.en: A corridor grows around every refused decision

labels.zh: 只有从隔壁房间才能抵达这里的天花板
labels.en: This ceiling is reachable only from the next room

labels.zh: 边界会向被修好的东西迁移
labels.en: Boundaries migrate toward whatever you mend

labels.zh: 只有站在地图之外，它才准确
labels.en: The map is accurate only from outside it

labels.zh: 两个地方越接近，能共享的东西越少
labels.en: The closer two places become, the less they can share

labels.zh: 你看见的伤痕其实是一组指示
labels.en: The damage you see is a set of instructions

labels.zh: 名字只有在被更改后才看得见
labels.en: Names become visible only after they change

labels.zh: 声音会暴露物品想变成什么
labels.en: Sound reveals what objects want to become

labels.zh: 每个谎言都会抹去说话者的一处细节
labels.en: Each lie removes one detail from the speaker

labels.zh: 线索每被分享一次，就会变得更难使用
labels.en: Clues become less useful each time they are shared

labels.zh: 你能预览后果，却看不见产生它的选择
labels.en: You can inspect consequences but not the choices that cause them

labels.zh: 世界会用你最近的失误为你命名
labels.en: The world names you after your latest mistake

labels.en: The tutorial explains only what another player can do

labels.zh: 越靠近家，行李箱就越重
labels.en: A suitcase that grows heavier near home

labels.zh: 一根把缝隙织进实体的针
labels.en: A needle that stitches gaps into solid things

labels.zh: 由旧密码制成的肥皂
labels.en: Soap made from old passwords

labels.zh: 只有拿错它的人才能敲响的铃
labels.en: A bell that rings only for the wrong holder

labels.zh: 一根系在你最后悔离开之处的绳
labels.en: A rope tied to the place you most regret leaving

labels.zh: 一双记得所有未走之路的鞋
labels.en: Shoes that remember every road you avoided

labels.zh: 伤害只能被储存在装饰品里
labels.en: Damage can be stored only in decorations

labels.zh: 一种能力必须先被送给别人，才能再次使用
labels.en: An ability must be given away before it can be used again

labels.zh: 库存中的物品会投票决定你能使用什么
labels.en: Inventory items vote on what you may use

labels.zh: 未走的路变成资源，用过的资源变成道路
labels.en: Unused paths become resources, and spent resources become paths

labels.zh: 只有名字正在消失时，才能修改规则
labels.en: You may change the rules only while losing your name

labels.zh: 重建消耗的是物品的历史，而不是材料
labels.en: Rebuilding consumes an object's history instead of materials

labels.en: Escort an abandoned ending back to its story

labels.zh: 找出哪栋房子正在假装成你的家
labels.en: Find which house is pretending to be your home

labels.zh: 在日出前教会一片废墟一种新用途
labels.en: Teach a ruin one new purpose before sunrise

labels.en: The pause menu is ashamed to be opened

labels.zh: 所有提示框都在争夺结局的位置
labels.en: Every tooltip is competing to become the ending

labels.en: Keep the system predictable or keep it alive?

labels.zh: 哪一场意外值得成为传统？
labels.en: Which accident deserves to become a tradition?

labels.en: Share the same minute with everyone or let them live it in sequence?

labels.zh: 保留指示，还是保留怀疑它们的能力？
labels.en: Keep the instructions or keep the ability to doubt them?

labels.zh: 保住这次收成，还是保住孕育它的土壤？
labels.en: Save this harvest or save the soil that produced it?

labels.zh: 带着痛苦的记忆，还是失去它保护的技能？
labels.en: Keep the painful memory or lose the skill it protects?

labels.zh: 让沉默的引擎重新运转，还是听完它最后的话？
labels.en: Restart the silent engine or hear its final message?

labels.zh: 让风暴服从规则，还是服从意图？
labels.en: Should the storm obey rules or intentions?

labels.zh: 哪一笔债应该在你离开后继续存在？
labels.en: Which debt should outlive you?

labels.zh: 现在使用明天的解法，还是把它留给你看不见的问题？
labels.en: Use tomorrow's solution now or save it for an unseen problem?

labels.zh: 抹去日期，还是抹去发生过的事？
labels.en: Erase the date or erase what happened?

labels.zh: 用多余的资源喂它，还是用你的确定感喂它？
labels.en: Feed it your surplus or feed it your certainty?

labels.zh: 当你无法再决定时，谁应该替你决定？
labels.en: Who should decide when you no longer can?

labels.zh: 现在用掉最后一次选择，还是保留一个无法查看的可能？
labels.en: Spend your last choice or preserve one hidden possibility?

labels.zh: 让世界原谅你的错误，还是让它准确记住？
labels.en: Should the world forgive your mistake or remember it exactly?

labels.zh: 在结局前重新开始，还是完成一个失去开端的故事？
labels.en: Restart before the ending or finish a story with no beginning?

labels.zh: 让教程获胜，还是继续按照它的规则玩？
labels.en: Let the tutorial win or keep playing by its rules?

labels.zh: 让规则保持公平，还是让例外保有人情？
labels.en: Keep the rule fair or keep its exceptions humane?

labels.zh: 一场由许可组成的雪崩
labels.en: An avalanche of permissions

labels.zh: 一座由剩余时刻制成的钟
labels.en: A clock made from leftover moments

labels.zh: 一笔会预报天气的债
labels.en: A debt that predicts the weather

labels.zh: 一段从未发出过的声音留下的化石
labels.en: A fossil left by a sound that was never made

labels.zh: 一轮总把潮汐放错地方的月亮
labels.en: A moon that keeps misplacing its tides

labels.en: A leash held by the consequence

labels.en: Each accusation changes which body accepts your controls

labels.en: Crossing a shadow reverses one joint in your body

labels.en: Events moved earlier lose location; events delayed gain one

labels.en: Finishing early adds another yesterday to the calendar

labels.en: Each skipped cutscene becomes a playable rumor

labels.en: Holding an action recruits more characters to control it

labels.en: Each visit removes one local rule and adds one traveler rule

labels.en: Heat migrates toward whatever is used least

labels.en: A local guide can enter every destination except their birthplace

labels.en: The narrator and avatar disagree about which one can move

labels.en: Your ancestor edits your posture; you choose their voice

labels.en: One character owns the body; another owns its reputation

labels.en: One character lives in deadlines; the other lives in durations

labels.en: The sidekick believes the camera is the real hero

labels.zh: 对手会为自己成功预测的行动支付代价
labels.en: Your opponent pays the costs of actions they predict correctly

labels.en: One twin lives inside the intervals the other cannot remember

labels.en: Events queue by emotional intensity, not arrival time

labels.en: Past actions return only during unrelated events

labels.zh: 同时完成的动作会交换彼此的历史
labels.en: Simultaneous actions exchange their histories when completed

labels.en: The loop repeats intervals between inputs, not the inputs

labels.en: An event may happen twice only if its consequences arrive in different orders

labels.en: Time advances when two moving objects exchange speeds

labels.en: The current controller is whoever has waited longest

labels.en: Control passes whenever two events overlap

labels.en: Autosave occurs only during actions the game cannot classify

labels.en: A settlement moves by exchanging its outskirts with neighbors

labels.en: A path becomes local only after someone uses it to leave

labels.en: Your silhouette is the border between two controllable bodies

labels.en: Locations are stacked by deadline, not by height

labels.en: Space unfolds toward the last failed movement

labels.zh: 每个方向都由不同的角色控制
labels.en: Each direction has a different controller

labels.en: Sand turns every pause in movement into a boundary

labels.en: Carried damage determines which borders admit you

labels.en: Your portrait shows who will control your next move, not who you are

labels.en: The aim indicator shows what a target will control after being hit

labels.en: Warnings appear only for hazards already influencing your controls

labels.en: Quest markers point to whoever treats you as side content

labels.en: Every sign reveals who may read it, not what it says

labels.en: A key that locks every place it has visited

labels.en: A glove that lends your dominant hand to an object

labels.en: A metronome that schedules collisions instead of beats

labels.en: A whistle that lets the loudest object issue the next command

labels.en: A trophy that unlocks whatever defeated you

labels.en: A bottle cap that changes the pressure of open space

labels.en: An eraser that removes ownership but leaves the object

labels.en: Control an object only after predicting its autonomous move

labels.en: Actions may be queued only while their outcomes remain unknown

labels.en: Cooldowns advance only while another ability is fully charged

labels.en: Items may be used only outside the region where they were found

labels.en: Cancel one choice only by completing a different choice

labels.en: Deliver a town's shadow to the people who left

labels.en: Recover actions credited to the wrong character

labels.en: Prevent a disaster without becoming its recorded cause

labels.en: Ragdoll physics is rehearsing the dialogue choices

labels.en: Save slots are trading unfinished side quests

labels.en: The combo counter is adopting the enemies it counts

labels.en: Merge two weak tools or keep them independently replaceable?

labels.en: Preserve the right to refuse or the chance to retry?

labels.en: Set the cost before the choice or let the outcome determine it?

labels.en: Save the resource that unlocks actions or the actions that replenish it?

labels.en: Keep one decision private or make its aftermath shared?

labels.en: Which two systems should share a failure state?

labels.en: Keep the signal synchronized or keep its receivers independent?

labels.zh: 保留一项私人行动，还是把它变成公共资源？
labels.en: Keep an action private or turn it into a public resource?

labels.en: Which breakdown has become essential infrastructure?

labels.zh: 什么可以消失，却不减少可能性的数量？
labels.en: What can disappear without reducing the number of possibilities?

labels.en: Should the material harden around pressure or around patience?

labels.en: Trust the method that can lie or the result that cannot explain itself?

labels.en: Give everyone the same evidence or give each person a way to verify it?

labels.en: Take responsibility for maintaining the solution or replacing it in time?

labels.en: Who should pay when a safe action creates risk elsewhere?

labels.en: An orbit shared by two unrelated centers

labels.en: A splint for a collapsing rhythm

labels.en: A queue missing one person from every position

labels.en: An alphabet mourning one of its shapes

labels.en: Resin formed from delayed sunlight

labels.en: A current braided from different temperatures

labels.en: A coin with neither side chosen

labels.en: The watermark of an impossible source

labels.en: Proof that changes material when tested

labels.en: An invoice sent by a harmless action

labels.en: A maintenance schedule for collateral damage

labels.en: A pronoun with fingerprints

labels.en: A transferred object leaves its friction with the giver

labels.en: When one player stops, another gains their unused direction

labels.en: Restoring a function changes the material required for the next repair

labels.en: Each repair makes an object compatible with fewer characters

labels.en: Maintenance returns a machine to where it first failed

labels.en: Discarding a category makes all its members indistinguishable

labels.en: Fungus copies the last cooperative action performed nearby

labels.en: Every optional action delays one mandatory action

labels.en: Each false alarm makes one real hazard movable

labels.en: Every shared success assigns someone a private cleanup task

labels.en: Two players share one cooldown but recover it through different actions

labels.en: The messenger can speak only while the recipient keeps moving

labels.en: Your ally can use your tools only while unseen by you

labels.en: The patient's recovery repairs the healer's tools

labels.en: One character remembers event order; another remembers what happened

labels.en: Your partner restores any lost action by performing it first

labels.en: A rival decides which of your two tools remains optional

labels.en: One sees rules before they apply; another sees them after they expire

labels.en: Your teammate owns the repair; you own the maintenance

labels.en: Partners share a beat only while moving in opposite directions

labels.en: Repairing a timeline preserves effects but reassigns their dates

labels.en: Time remembers duration but forgets order

labels.en: Delay one future only by accelerating another

labels.en: Clocks agree only when each is wrong differently

labels.en: The future charges upkeep for objects kept unchanged

labels.en: Noon occurs wherever two cooldowns end together

labels.en: Separate floors share the same empty volume

labels.en: Repairing a boundary changes which side counts as damaged

labels.en: A room keeps the dimensions of objects removed from it

labels.en: Ice expands toward heat instead of melting

labels.zh: 只有东西沉下去之后，水才会获得深度
labels.en: Water gains depth only after something sinks

labels.zh: 藤蔓会把朝向相反的表面系在一起
labels.en: Vines tie together surfaces facing opposite directions

labels.en: Dust settles into temporary stairs after sound stops

labels.en: Every room has one dimension you can spend

labels.en: Compressing space requires equal expansion somewhere else

labels.en: A signal shows how receivers changed it, not what was sent

labels.en: A repaired surface shows the next failure, not its current condition

labels.zh: 被删除的分类只会以排序错误的形式显现
labels.en: Deleted categories appear only as sorting errors

labels.zh: 温度显示附近有多少条路径汇合
labels.en: Temperature reveals how many paths converge nearby

labels.zh: 界面显示哪个选项可以撤销，却隐藏撤销代价
labels.en: The interface shows which option is reversible but hides the reversal cost

labels.zh: 真相是唯一不受当前规则影响的物品
labels.en: Truth is the object unaffected by the current rule

labels.zh: 只有让两段距离暂时相等，才能验证它们
labels.en: Distances can be verified only by making them temporarily equal

labels.zh: 陈述的来源靠近时，它的重量会改变
labels.en: A statement changes weight when its source is nearby

labels.en: You can see who benefits, but not who will pay

labels.en: A two-ended pencil that writes in separate worlds

labels.zh: 一把把两种不兼容状态固定在一起的夹钳
labels.en: A clamp that holds two incompatible states together

labels.zh: 一种只溶解旧修补痕迹的溶剂
labels.en: A solvent that dissolves only previous repairs

labels.zh: 一把会被遗忘距离缩短的尺子
labels.en: A ruler shortened by forgotten distances

labels.zh: 一只越装满越轻的陶杯
labels.en: A ceramic cup that grows lighter as it fills

labels.zh: 一枚可当作距离或权限花费的代币
labels.en: A token spendable as distance or permission

labels.zh: 一张只在承载虚假陈述时变透明的纸
labels.en: Paper that becomes transparent only under a false statement

labels.zh: 资源只有在两名玩家选择不同用途时才能被消耗
labels.en: A resource can be spent only when two players choose different uses

labels.zh: 物品只有在类别未知时才能使用
labels.en: Items remain usable only while their category is unknown

labels.zh: 被预览过的可选行动会变成强制行动
labels.en: Previewed optional actions become mandatory

labels.zh: 只有修复收益来源的人才能领取收益
labels.en: A benefit may be claimed only by whoever repaired its source

labels.zh: 只有不进行任何操作时，玩家才能覆盖系统控制
labels.en: Override the system only while providing no input

labels.zh: 用对完成状态意见不一的零件重建机器
labels.en: Rebuild a machine from parts that disagree about being finished

labels.zh: 教会河流分流，同时不让它变成两条河
labels.en: Teach a river to divide without becoming two rivers

labels.en: Return every borrowed advantage without undoing what it enabled

labels.en: The character select screen merges people with every hovered role

labels.en: Fast-travel points are forming a country

labels.en: The inventory grid is hosting a cooking show for unequipped items

labels.en: Who are you when none of your permissions apply?

labels.en: Should the body adapt to its tools or the tools adapt to the body?

labels.en: Join the group sharing your route or the group sharing your destination?

labels.en: What must a place provide before leaving it becomes betrayal?

labels.en: Should an exploit remain secret, become a mechanic, or become a level?

labels.zh: 哪一种延迟应该可被控制，却永远无法消除？
labels.en: Which delay should be controllable but never removable?

labels.en: What must happen simultaneously to remain independent?

labels.zh: 哪项功能应该从界面消失，却继续存在于世界中？
labels.en: Which feature should vanish from the interface but remain in the world?

labels.zh: 什么在失去意义之后仍应保持功能？
labels.en: What should remain functional after losing its meaning?

labels.en: Who is responsible for a system that works only when nobody maintains it?

labels.en: Let erosion reveal the route or erase the reason to take it?

labels.en: Make an option reversible or make it teachable to others?

labels.zh: 哪一条事实应该在可信之前就能被使用？
labels.en: Which fact should be usable before it becomes believable?

labels.en: A portrait of the controller painted by the controlled character

labels.en: An identity with a detachable center of balance

labels.zh: 一份只在两个目的地之间有效的公民身份
labels.en: A citizenship valid only between destinations

labels.zh: 一座为已消失地点设立的使馆
labels.en: An embassy for places that no longer exist

labels.en: A side quest made entirely of main-menu sounds

labels.zh: 一个专门记录犹豫时间的速通分段
labels.en: A speedrun split devoted to hesitation

labels.zh: 让机器拒绝指令，还是让指令拒绝机器？
labels.en: Let machines reject commands or let commands reject machines?

labels.zh: 保留提前警告，还是让它只能在危险源附近生效？
labels.en: Keep a warning early or make it usable only near its source?

labels.zh: 恢复零件容错，还是降低整体系统所需精度？
labels.en: Restore the component's tolerance or reduce the precision required by the whole system?

labels.zh: 修复能量路径，还是修复能量变成废料的位置？
labels.en: Repair the energy path or repair where energy becomes waste?

labels.zh: 选择改变问题的工具，还是改变工具的问题？
labels.en: Choose the tool that changes the problem or the problem that changes the tool?

labels.zh: 找回缺失事件，还是找回它留在其他日程中的空档？
labels.en: Recover the missing event or recover the gap it left in other schedules?

labels.zh: 保留无主记忆，还是交给无法相信它的人？
labels.en: Keep a memory ownerless or give it to someone unable to believe it?

labels.zh: 留在行动合法之处，还是前往后果归属之地？
labels.en: Stay where your actions are legal or move where their consequences belong?

labels.zh: 一道由测量投下的影子
labels.en: A shadow cast by a measurement

labels.zh: 一个无法重复之事实的语法
labels.en: The grammar of an unrepeatable fact

labels.zh: 一笔以被阻止行动计价的债
labels.en: A debt denominated in prevented actions

labels.zh: 一封收件人是规则的道歉
labels.en: An apology addressed to a rule

labels.zh: 一个用于静音连锁反应的按钮
labels.en: A mute button for a chain reaction

labels.zh: 一张允许仪器违抗测量结果的许可证
labels.en: A license permitting an instrument to disobey its measurement

labels.zh: 一个开始的过期日期
labels.en: The expiration date of a beginning

labels.zh: 一块形状与无法修复之错误相同的补丁
labels.en: A patch shaped like the error it cannot fix

labels.zh: 一个用于无中心运动的轴承
labels.en: A bearing for a movement with no center

labels.zh: 一个留给游戏不在场证明的物品栏槽位
labels.en: An inventory slot reserved for the game's alibi

labels.zh: 每次比较都会改变下一次比较的基准
labels.en: Each comparison changes the baseline for the next one

labels.zh: 伤害被命名后停止扩张，却失去传播方向
labels.en: Naming harm stops its radius from growing but erases its direction

labels.zh: 每个被接受的风险都会成为受损者可用的工具
labels.en: Every accepted risk becomes a tool usable by whoever it harms

labels.zh: 每次离开都会让一件公共物品变为私人可用
labels.en: Each departure makes one public object privately usable

labels.zh: 行动越早完成，它的准备阶段越晚发生
labels.en: Completing an action early makes its preparation happen later

labels.zh: 选定结果会移除对应动作，却保留准备过程
labels.en: Choosing an outcome removes its verb but keeps its preparation

labels.zh: 每条被忽略的指令都会改变下条指令的接收系统
labels.en: Each ignored command changes which system can hear the next one

labels.zh: 忘记数量会让对应物品开始像群体一样行动
labels.en: Forgetting a count makes the matching objects behave as a crowd

labels.zh: 一人负责测量，另一人决定哪些差异有意义
labels.en: One measures; the other decides which differences matter

labels.zh: 一人只能陈述事实，另一人只能把事实重新变成问题
labels.en: One states facts; the other can only turn them back into questions

labels.zh: 一人佩戴另一人未使用的视角
labels.en: One character wears the other's unused perspective

labels.zh: 一人携带另一人不再需要的一切
labels.en: One character carries everything the other no longer needs

labels.zh: 一人拥有工具，另一人拥有工具造成的磨损
labels.en: One owns the tools; the other owns the wear they create

labels.zh: 一人携带本地习俗，另一人携带习俗产生的例外
labels.en: One carries local customs; the other carries the exceptions those customs create

labels.zh: 一人在信号到达前行动，另一人在信号停止后行动
labels.en: One acts before a signal arrives; the other acts after it stops

labels.zh: 一人选择什么可以改变，另一人选择什么必须不可比较
labels.en: One chooses what may change; the other chooses what must remain incomparable

labels.zh: 证据更换持有者时，事实会失效
labels.en: A fact expires whenever its evidence changes owner

labels.zh: 连接只能在两端交换角色的瞬间行动
labels.en: A link may act only during the moment its endpoints exchange roles

labels.zh: 指令效果抵达第二个系统时，控制权就会失效
labels.en: Control over a command expires when its effect reaches a second system

labels.zh: 修好的时钟会跳过所有本该准确的时刻
labels.en: A repaired clock skips every moment when it would be accurate

labels.zh: 每次循环都把你的名字交给最旧的未完成行动
labels.en: Each cycle gives your name to your oldest unfinished action

labels.zh: 每次回忆都会推迟原事件留下的感受
labels.en: Each recollection delays the sensation left by the original event

labels.zh: 责任方更换工具时，后果会暂停
labels.en: A consequence pauses while the responsible actor changes tools

labels.zh: 一个地方只在打包后、首件物品搬走前算作家
labels.en: A place counts as home only between packing and moving the first object

labels.zh: 一段持续时间只能在不属于任一半的时刻切开
labels.en: A duration may be split only at a moment belonging to neither half

labels.zh: 珊瑚生长在相容规则之间的边界上
labels.en: Coral grows along boundaries between compatible rules

labels.zh: 被选路线会在最容易的位置变得最窄
labels.en: A chosen route becomes narrowest where it was easiest

labels.zh: 房间距离由它能容纳的真命题数量决定
labels.en: A room's distance equals the number of true statements it can contain

labels.zh: 两个表面只有在无法相对时才算相邻
labels.en: Two surfaces are adjacent only when neither can face the other

labels.zh: 移动轴属于区域，而不是角色
labels.en: Movement axes belong to regions rather than characters

labels.zh: 物品栏有一道会让已分类物品沉没的地平线
labels.en: The inventory has a horizon that sorted objects fall behind

labels.zh: 裂缝只能从它未通向的房间修复
labels.en: A crack can be repaired only from a room it does not open into

labels.zh: 缺失物品通过房间混响的变化被听见
labels.en: Missing objects are audible through changes in room reverberation

labels.zh: 后果颜色显示仍可控制它的行动
labels.en: A consequence's color shows which action can still contain it

labels.zh: 本地物品只有被外来者携带时才显出轮廓
labels.en: Local objects gain silhouettes only while carried by an outsider

labels.zh: 动态模糊显示行动还能被中断多久
labels.en: Motion blur shows how long an action remains interruptible

labels.zh: 花粉通过拒绝落下揭示隐形路径
labels.en: Pollen reveals invisible paths by refusing to settle on them

labels.zh: 证据只从最不具说服力的视角可见
labels.en: Evidence is visible only from the viewpoint that makes it least convincing

labels.zh: 一条连接两段顺序而非布料的拉链
labels.en: A zipper that joins two sequences instead of fabrics

labels.zh: 一个释放许可而非液体的阀门
labels.en: A valve that releases permission instead of fluid

labels.zh: 一个支撑移动关系而非物品的支架
labels.en: A brace that supports a moving relationship instead of an object

labels.zh: 一面捕获被遗忘数量、却放过物品的筛网
labels.en: A sieve that catches forgotten quantities but lets objects pass

labels.zh: 一把只有无人受益时才开启的挂锁
labels.en: A padlock that opens only when nobody benefits

labels.zh: 携带一条从未使用的路线时才能进入家园
labels.en: You may enter home only while carrying a route nobody has used

labels.zh: 行动只能在另一行动的后果中开始
labels.en: An action may begin only inside the aftermath of a different action

labels.zh: 植物只能生长在被它们改变温度的表面
labels.en: Plants may grow only on surfaces whose temperature they changed

labels.zh: 陈述只能由无法显示它的系统使用
labels.en: A statement may be used only by systems unable to display it

labels.zh: 让两个互相无法检测的流程同时完成
labels.en: Make two processes finish together without allowing either to detect the other

labels.zh: 不向个体下令，引导自主群体形成精确图案
labels.en: Guide an autonomous crowd into an exact pattern without directing individuals

labels.zh: 制作人员表正在把违禁品藏进标点符号
labels.en: The credits are hiding contraband inside punctuation

labels.zh: 让一个选项成为前提，还是成为后果？
labels.en: Make one option a prerequisite or make it a consequence?

labels.zh: 让两个选择彼此独立，还是让任一选择改变另一个的含义？
labels.en: Keep two choices independent or let either choice change what the other means?

labels.zh: 通过共同观察者连接，还是通过共同盲区连接？
labels.en: Connect through a shared observer or through a shared blind spot?

labels.zh: 一条拥有新陈代谢的河流
labels.en: A river with a metabolism

labels.zh: 每个被证伪的地图符号都会变成测量单位
labels.en: Each disproved map symbol becomes a unit of measurement

labels.zh: 每避开一个捕食者，栖息地就长出一个无害仿体
labels.en: Avoiding a predator makes its habitat grow a harmless imitation

labels.zh: 每建立一条连接，都会让一个未连接系统产生延迟
labels.en: Each new connection creates a delay in a system that was not linked

labels.zh: 一人的伤痕是另一人的技能树
labels.en: One person's scars are the other person's skill tree

labels.zh: 成就只能在输入发出后、画面响应前获得
labels.en: Achievements can be earned only between an input and its on-screen response

labels.zh: 轮廓显示哪一个过去的自己拥有当前位置
labels.en: Your outline shows which past version of you owns the current position

labels.zh: 一个调节每个结果可拥有多少原因的节流阀
labels.en: A throttle that limits how many causes each effect may have

labels.zh: 一块吸引用途已被遗忘之物的磁铁
labels.en: A magnet that attracts objects whose purpose has been forgotten

labels.zh: 修复后的零件必须先在另一系统中失效，才能再次使用
labels.en: A repaired component may be reused only after failing in a different system

labels.zh: 暂停图标正在举报移动平台的碰撞事故
labels.en: The pause icon is filing collision reports against moving platforms

labels.zh: 让一个物件解决许多问题，还是让许多物件共同解决一个问题？
labels.en: Let one object solve many problems or let many objects solve one problem?

labels.zh: 当两个物件的影子重叠、物件本身却没有接触时，它们会鼓掌
labels.en: Two objects applaud when their shadows overlap but their bodies do not
